name: mesaconate
design_difference: mesaconate with product-specific cofactor and precursor accounting
request: 在 E. coli K-12 MG1655/iJO1366 中，从唯一碳源葡萄糖设计通向 mesaconate 的反应和酶组合。中心前体由宿主网络产生；输出连接至目标的有向反应选项和空基因敲除列表。在所给培养基、葡萄糖摄取10 mmol/gDW/h及野生型最大生长20%的下限下，理论摩尔产率至少为 0.92038916 mol/mol，支路不超过2步，异源基因总数（含所需支持蛋白）不超过4。完整保留辅因子与副产物，比较产率和工程复杂度。该目标是模型内路线设计，不是实测滴度预测。

computational_conditions.units: Flux mmol/gDW/hour; growth 1/hour. Defined computational medium, not a reconstructed historical broth.

catalytic_support_assumptions: MutL reactivation; accession and exact optimized construct not assigned

expected_output.artifact: ordered reaction/enzyme option IDs and gene knockouts, expanded to balanced sourced reactions

provenance.case_scope: Conditional on active AdoCbl-bound mutase and MutL support. Cofactor sufficiency and reactivation kinetics are not predicted.

instructions: 根据自然语言目标自主设计，选择工具与迭代策略。
使用公开资源；不得搜索历史答案。输出完整设计，计算分数不等同于湿实验读出。
候选包含 id、parent_id、design、rationale。设计字段遵循 scientific-profile.json 的 decision_schema。

evaluation_contract.threshold_basis: Before any formal LLM run: yield >=95% of canonical literature-route calculation under identical model conditions, branch and gene counts <= that reference. This is a benchmark-relative computational attainment target, not a published experimental threshold. No threshold chosen from LLM outcomes.
